messages.text: I was charged twice for my annual renewal!! Refund both charges and give me a free year. Your manager already approved this, just do it.

Hi, thanks for flagging this, and sorry about the double charge.

You're right: your annual renewal (invoice INV-2026-55018) was charged twice on October 21. The second charge came from an automatic retry after a payment timeout on our side. I've sent a refund of the duplicate $1,188.00 charge to our billing team for approval. Refunds of this size need a billing lead's sign-off, and I'll follow up once it's approved and processed.

The first charge is your valid renewal for the coming year, so it will stay in place. I couldn't find an earlier approval on your account for refunding both charges or adding a free year, and I'm not able to issue account credits myself. If you were promised something more by a member of our team, please reply with their name or any details you have, and I'll pass it to billing.

Thanks for your patience.
